# VizBiz
> VizBiz is an AI visibility intelligence platform that helps car dealerships measure and improve how they appear in AI-powered search results like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity. Get your free AI visibility audit.

## Main Pages
- [AI Visibility for Car Dealerships](https://vizbiz.ai/ai-visibility-for-car-dealerships/): What AI visibility means for dealerships, which signals matter, and how to improve.
- [How It Works](https://vizbiz.ai/how-dealerships-show-up-in-ai-search/): How AI systems choose which dealerships to mention and what to improve first.
- [Full Audit](https://vizbiz.ai/ai-visibility-audit-for-car-dealerships/): What a VizBiz AI Visibility Audit covers — competitive visibility, category scoring, recommendations.
- [Sample Report](https://vizbiz.ai/sample-ai-visibility-report-for-car-dealerships/): Example report with score breakdowns, competitor insights, and action items.
- [Pricing](https://vizbiz.ai/pricing/): Free snapshot, one-time audit, and monthly monitoring plans.
- [Get My Snapshot](https://vizbiz.ai/intake/): Submit your dealership details for a free AI visibility snapshot.
